metadata.description: AI text detection and rewriting tools

plugins.name: department-of-prose
plugins.description: Score recurring patterns associated with formulaic or AI-like prose, explain them, and rewrite the passage in Claude Code and Codex. Three skills: slop-sense (score + rewrite + ai;dr), slop-check (score only, no rewrite), and slop-explain (per-pattern deep-dives). Includes a 0-100 SLOP scorer and a separate rhythm checker.
